$comment: Fixes knext bundles for vinext ahead of upstream releases. `vinext` is the ONLY version these patches were validated against; `pristine` records the sha256 of each target file in that published tarball. Bumping the vinext pin without re-porting and re-validating every patch fails vinext-patches.test.ts.

patches.summary: Pages Router: a `/_next/data/...` request reaches getServerSideProps with the original data URL as `req.url` (Next.js parity), not the normalized page path.
Server builds: a `require()` of a CommonJS dependency resolves the package's `require` export condition even when Vite would externalize that package.
Nitro builds: a `turbopack.resolveExtensions` list without `.mjs` no longer hides Nitro's own preset entry (the build failed to resolve it).
Nitro builds: dependencies of the RSC environment are bundled, so a package's `react-server` export condition is honoured.
Web Worker bundles: `process.env.NEXT_DEPLOYMENT_ID` is inlined, as it is in the rest of the app.
Nitro builds: `outputFileTracingIncludes` / `outputFileTracingExcludes` from next.config are applied to the traced server dependencies.
